title: Epidemiology of Severe Peroperative Bleeding During Scheduled Surgery
brief_summary: Peroperative bleeding has been studied in specific populations exposed to bleeding (i.e. cardiac surgery, orthopedic surgery). Epidemiology of peroperative bleeding and transfusion remain poorly studied in the whole cohort of patients scheduled for surgery remain unknown. The investigators conducted a prospective study in order to examine the incidence, and risk factors associated with peroperative bleeding and transfusion.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient scheduled for non cardiac and non emergency surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cardiac surgery
* Emergency surgery
study_population: Consecutive patients scheduled for surgery (expect cardiac, pediatric, and emergency surgery)
